summary_en: 270,000 shares (1.50% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-19 at ¥2,405/share (closing price 2026-06-18); total acquisition limit ¥649.35M; order valid for single trading session only; settlement to follow market close.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: World Holdings (ticker 2429) announced on 2026-06-18 a buyback block of 270,000 shares (1.50% of shares outstanding, calculated as 270,000 ÷ 17,898,731 ex-treasury shares) via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading. The acquisition limit is ¥649.35M (upper bound), executed at ¥2,405 per share (closing price of 2026-06-18). The order will be placed at 08:45 JST on 2026-06-19 for the single trading session at that time; results will be published after market close that day. The company stated the buyback strengthens shareholder returns through improved capital efficiency and enables flexible capital policy in response to changing business and market conditions. Execution is not guaranteed if market conditions prevent full participation. The company noted it had received communications from certain shareholders indicating their intent to sell holdings.
